description: GET lists the operation indicators published for NBS 115011000 on the competence date and POST validates the compatible cIndOp 100301 x cClassTrib 000001 combination. The request body is NfseValidacaoIndicadorOperacaoInput (cClassTrib, cIndOp, dataOcorrenciaFatoGerador, nbs — all required; cTribNac optional, see error-ctribnac-seis-digitos.json for why it is not sent).

response.localFornecimento: Local do domicílio principal do adquirente residente ou domiciliado no País. Nas aquisições indicadas no art. 11, §4º, II, considera-se domicílio principal do adquirente o estabelecimento matriz
